objective.primary: CKT v5.1 shape-only member normalized to the S005 keytao member
secondary: minimize explicit memory M after its definition is frozen
maximize occupied toned-syllable buckets out of 441

topology.firstKeyDomain: 21 sound keys; component semantics depend on secondCodeFactorization
topology.secondKeyDomain: 3 tone rows x 7 factorization-specific component columns
topology.shapeKeysByMeaning: search variable over the 120 permutations of QAOPL

toneRows.mergeRule: exactly one lexical-tone pair and two singleton groups

candidates.firstComponent: 书写声母（含规则零声母分型）

secondCodeFactorization.priorResearchBoundary: R11 defines the decomposition templates and deeply studies the shengjie Pindu family with 25/26 physical second keys; it does not select a winner for seven shared columns per tone row.
secondCodeFactorization.columnConstraint: derive the second-component inventory and legal aliases separately for each candidate; do not assume 35 full finals before selecting a factorization

wordContract.name: traditional-21x21-native-six-code
wordContract.word2: four main plus two shape auxiliaries
wordContract.word3: three main plus three shape auxiliaries
wordContract.word4: four main plus two shape auxiliaries
wordContract.candidateRanking: word2+word4 joint same-length pool; independent staged word3 pool; no soft length balance

shapeAuxiliaryOrder.selection: default-point CKT v5.1 plus the existing wide cognitive-cost robustness grid

search.phase0: freeze QAOPL, tone normalization, bucket, memory, and CKT normalization semantics
search.phase1: compare factorization feasibility and collision lower bounds under the same fixed QAOPL 3x7 topology
search.phase2: build deterministic scorers for surviving factorizations and reproduce the upper4/home32/lower10 baseline
search.phase3: audit all 36 lexical-tone row assignments and neutral-tone sensitivity
search.phase4: jointly search first-component placement, seven second-component columns, and the 120 shape-key meaning orders under CKT v5.1
search.phase5: re-optimize and robustly audit the 144 shape-auxiliary orders
search.phase6: Pareto audit CKT v5.1, M, bucket use, collision cost, and ergonomics
